questions.q: What does Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager actually produce for an organization?
options: A compliance score against a chosen framework, with a list of specific technical and non-technical improvement actions
A list of AWS resources only, with no Azure coverage
A single binary pass/fail result with no detail on what's missing
An automatic ISO 27001 certificate with no auditor involved
questions.explain: Compliance Manager scores the environment against a chosen regulation or standard and lists specific completed and outstanding actions, including non-technical ones like written policies.

questions.q: How do Azure Policy regulatory compliance initiatives relate to the Defender for Cloud compliance dashboard covered in Chapter 5?
options: They are what actually feeds that dashboard — assigning an initiative evaluates real resource configurations and reports results into it
Regulatory compliance initiatives only work for AWS resources, not Azure
They are completely unrelated tools with no connection to each other
Defender for Cloud replaces the need for Azure Policy entirely
questions.explain: Azure Policy initiatives are built-in bundles of policy definitions mapped to named frameworks; assigning one continuously evaluates resources and reports results straight into the dashboard from Chapter 5.

questions.q: What does AWS Audit Manager actually do?
options: Continuously collects evidence against a chosen prebuilt framework from sources like AWS Config, CloudTrail, and Security Hub
Only evaluates AWS IAM permissions, with no other evidence sources
Replaces the need for any AWS Config rules
Manually creates written security policies with no automation
questions.explain: Audit Manager continuously gathers evidence automatically from existing AWS services and organizes it by control, so most evidence is ready before a real audit starts.

questions.q: What is an AWS Config conformance pack?
options: A one-time report with no ongoing evaluation
A manual checklist with no automated evaluation
A feature exclusive to Microsoft Azure, not AWS
A single deployable collection of AWS Config rules, and optionally remediation actions, that evaluates resources against an entire framework at once
questions.explain: A conformance pack deploys an entire framework's worth of Config rules as a single unit, instead of requiring each rule to be wired up individually.

questions.q: Which prebuilt frameworks can AWS Audit Manager collect evidence against, according to this lesson?
options: Only internal AWS-specific frameworks with no external standards
Only GDPR, with no other frameworks supported
Audit Manager does not support any prebuilt frameworks
SOC 2, PCI DSS, CIS Benchmarks, and ISO 27001, among others
questions.explain: AWS Audit Manager's prebuilt framework list includes SOC 2, PCI DSS, CIS Benchmarks, and ISO 27001, among others.
